quests.name: The Road She Runs
quests.desc: The personal reason she became a Free Road conductor — not the ideology version. The specific version that came first.

quests.name: Hit First, Reassessed
quests.pre: She hits first as policy. The player was already past her before she finished the assessment.
quests.scene: She does not hit first. She assesses. He passes. She tells him: 'You passed.' Not warm. Just accurate.
quests.post: She gives him one contact name he did not ask for.

quests.name: Pip Before the Road
quests.desc: How she found Pip, specifically. Why she kept her. What she told herself about it for the first year.

quests.name: Cared For Without the Debt
quests.pre: He has done something for her she did not ask for. She has been waiting three weeks for the invoice.
quests.scene: She asks: 'What do you want for it?' He says: 'Nothing.' She runs the full standard verification battery on this claim.
quests.post: She accepts it as probably true and immediately does three things for him to even a balance that did not need evening.

quests.name: The Indentured Year
quests.desc: Not the ideology version — what the specific year felt like from inside it. The moments she keeps returning to. What she decided the morning she ran.

quests.name: The Reversal She Allowed
quests.pre: She reverses everything. SADIST leads. MASOCHIST is the buried part.
quests.scene: He reverses it. She fights. He does not back down. She finds out what happens when she cannot reverse it — when the specific thing she has been fighting toward is right here.
quests.post: 'I was not sure I would let anyone.' Pause. 'I did not know I wanted to.'

quests.name: Being Looked After
quests.pre: She has been watching for the pattern that explains what this is.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — MASOCHIST lean fully active for the first time. She finds out what happens when she can just receive without performing, fighting, or managing. She is looked after. No invoice.
quests.post: She does not produce one.

quests.name: Feeding Without Counting
quests.pre: She cooked. She did not keep track of portions.
quests.scene: She makes him food and sits with him while he eats it. SWITCH lean in SERVICE direction. She does this without the running commentary about why it is purely tactical.
quests.post: 'I did not count the portions.' She sounds surprised. 'Interesting.'

quests.name: The Safe House She Built
quests.pre: She has built safe houses her whole life. This one is different.
quests.scene: She tells him this is the one she would stay at.
quests.post: She marks it. Different mark than the others.

quests.name: The Name She Gave Herself
quests.desc: Not what she was called before — just that there was one. That she decided one morning it was not it. What Pip means to her now.

quests.name: With, Not To
quests.pre: She has been watching carefully to see which one he is.
quests.scene: Something small — he checks if she is alright before moving forward. Nobody does this. She notes it.
quests.post: She moves slightly closer in formation for the next three days.

quests.name: The Lock She Learned On
quests.desc: The specific lock, the specific night, the specific click that felt like a new language.

quests.name: Choosing the Shortcut
quests.pre: She knows shortcuts nobody else knows. She has never shared all of them.
quests.scene: She shares one that only matters if you plan to stay. He takes it. She is beside him.
quests.post: She teaches him two more.

quests.name: What Cass Was For
quests.desc: What it meant to have someone before she had herself. That she still has Cass. That this is somehow a different category.

tags: Slave (chosen — the choosing is the point)
quests.name: The Choice That Is the Point
quests.pre: She has been building toward a specific choice. She knows what it is.
quests.scene: She makes it. Deliberately. With clear eyes. SUBMISSIVE/SURRENDER leans — she gives herself as a choice, not a consequence.
quests.post: 'That was mine.' She means: the choosing was mine. 'I wanted you to know that.'

quests.name: Belonging to Someone Who Asks First
quests.pre: Always done to, never done with.
quests.scene: He asks. Extended intimacy that escalates only as she allows. She escalates it — she is the one who escalates it.
quests.post: 'Again.' Not Ceira's word — different meaning. She wants to choose it again.

quests.name: Shortcut to Here
quests.pre: She mapped the shortest route to wherever he is.
quests.scene: She tells him she mapped it. She gives him the map.
quests.post: 'In case you get lost.'

quests.name: The Saltborn Three
quests.desc: Her grandfather, her mother, herself. What was passed down. What she broke. What she did not.

quests.name: The Contract That Does Not Need Renegotiating
quests.pre: Every relationship she has is either clearly contractual or clearly terminated.
quests.scene: He is asking nothing she did not agree to. She keeps waiting for the amendment.
quests.post: No amendment arrives. She updates the contract in her head to include a new clause she does not name.

quests.name: The Port She Returns To
quests.desc: There is one port she always comes back to — not for business. She has not examined why.

quests.name: The Helm at Night
quests.pre: She runs a tight watch schedule.
quests.scene: He is at the helm at 2am, not his rotation. She does not send him below. She stays. Near silence. Dark water moving.
quests.post: She adjusts the watch rotation to permanently include him in this slot. She does not mention this.

quests.name: Staying
quests.desc: The one time she stayed. What made her leave. That it was the right call and she has never been entirely sure.

quests.name: Something She Does Not Do on Ships
quests.pre: She has rules for ships.
quests.scene: She breaks one. EXHIBITIONIST lean — she is seen specifically, in her own space, by choice.
quests.post: 'I have rules about that.' Pause. 'I broke it.' Pause. 'Do not make me explain why.'

quests.name: Wanting To
quests.pre: She has been wanting to stay. She has not been able to name this as wanting.
quests.scene: DOMINANT/VANILLA hybrid — she runs this with characteristic capability and finds midway it is different from the transactional version. She notes the difference precisely.
quests.post: 'Different.'

quests.name: The New Navigation
quests.pre: She has been running new calculations.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — SWITCH fully active, EXHIBITIONIST as the frame. She wants to be seen wanting to stay. She is seen.
quests.post: She tells him the name of the port she always returns to. She has never told anyone.

quests.name: Cargo Worth Keeping
quests.pre: She has been carrying something she does not have manifest words for.
quests.scene: She declares it.
quests.post: She updates her navigation charts. Home port. First time it has a mark.

quests.name: The Grove She Logged Alone
quests.desc: Two months alone tracking the excavation before anyone believed her. What she found. What she decided about trusting institutions.

quests.name: The Assessment That Passed
quests.pre: She assessed him before he spoke.
quests.scene: Her assessment was wrong about one thing. She runs it again with the new data.
quests.post: She shares one piece of information she was not going to share.

quests.name: The Grove-Warden's Order
quests.desc: What it cost to ignore a direct order. Why she did it. Why she would do it again. Why this matters.

quests.name: Observed
quests.pre: She has been observing — VOYEUR lean, standard. She watches everything.
quests.scene: He observes her back with the same quality of attention she uses. She becomes aware mid-movement that she is the subject. She keeps moving. She does what she was doing more carefully.
quests.post: She looks for evidence he was watching. There is evidence. She keeps it.

quests.name: Carrying Alone
quests.desc: The full weight of what she knows about the excavation. How long she has been carrying it. What she has been waiting for.

quests.name: The Trust Test
quests.pre: She is setting a test.
quests.scene: She tells him where she is going without asking him to follow. He follows correctly — not close enough to crowd, not far enough to miss. She did not expect this level of calibration.
quests.post: She adjusts the test. New test. Same result.

quests.name: Reversal
quests.pre: She catches. DOMINANT and CONTROL lead. She captures.
quests.scene: REVERSAL CAPTURE — he turns it. Not forcefully — patiently, specifically. She fights twice. The third time she finds out there is a third possibility.
quests.post: She sits in the grove for a while. 'The grove is still here.' She sounds fine. She is fine. Different.

quests.name: What the Trees Watch
quests.pre: She has been in groves her whole life.
quests.scene: Extended scene — SADIST/VOYEUR inverted, she receives. She is fully seen. In her grove. In her space. On her terms but not by her choice.
quests.post: The grove is still here. She marks a tree.

quests.name: The Report She Filed
quests.pre: She has never filed a report saying she needed someone.
quests.scene: She does not file it formally. She says it once, plainly, in the grove. It is the same as filing.
quests.post: 'You can carry some of this.'

characters.name: Queen Ilvariel
characters.notes: Granite I — 15-18 quests spanning Acts 2-7. Opening arc recorded here.

quests.name: Four Centuries of the Same Room
quests.desc: What the court looks like after four hundred years. The one person who still surprises her — her husband. What surprised her about him this year.

quests.name: Not the Queen
quests.pre: She has been addressing every interaction from the Queen register.
quests.scene: He addresses her without the register — not disrespectfully, without it. Her response is slightly different. She notices.
quests.post: She examines this briefly. Reshelves it. Examines it again the following evening.

quests.name: The Person Not the Ruler
quests.desc: Four hundred years of being seen as the monarch. She describes the one moment she was seen differently and why she still thinks about it.

quests.name: The Watch She Keeps
quests.pre: She has begun watching him across formal situations. VOYEUR lean active.
quests.scene: He handles something directly, without court choreography. She is in the gallery. She watches for eleven minutes. She does not report this to her consort.
quests.post: She reviews his decision. It was correct. She was not watching to check his judgment.

quests.name: The Four Centuries That Do Not Explain This
quests.desc: Direct: she describes the one category of thing four hundred years of ruling has not taught her to handle. She is describing the player.

quests.name: The Calibration Error
quests.pre: She predicts everyone.
quests.scene: He does something she did not predict. She recalibrates. He deviates again. She has encountered approximately twelve people in four centuries who deviated twice.
quests.post: She takes a walk without her guard for the first time in three years.

quests.name: Above the Court
quests.pre: She has been managing her response with the precision of four centuries.
quests.scene: The management fails in one specific interaction. CONTROL lean meets its limit. She does not recover immediately.
quests.post: She recovers. It took forty-seven minutes. This is unprecedented.

quests.text: Granite arc continues Acts 4-7: marriage reckoning, political consequence, physical escalation, full mind break, and eventual fallen state. High-stakes design needed when Acts 4-7 content is in scope.

quests.name: Six Hundred Years Since
quests.desc: She describes her husband in the way of someone who has been describing him for six centuries — the most essential version, settled now.

quests.name: The One Sentence About Him
quests.pre: She says one sentence about her husband in every conversation.
quests.scene: She does not say it. The player notices. She notices he noticed.
quests.post: 'It is the first time I forgot.' She sounds quiet.

quests.name: The Precise Memory She Keeps
quests.desc: The one specific thing she did in his last year that she would do differently. She has tried to modify this memory for six centuries. It will not modify.

quests.name: Still There
quests.pre: She has been testing whether she can feel something without it becoming a loss.
quests.scene: She feels something. The test continues. She does not leave.
quests.post: 'Still intact.' She means: still herself.

quests.name: The Risk She Is Calculating
quests.pre: She has been calculating: if she allowed this and then lost it, whether she would survive it.
quests.scene: He waits. He does not require her to resolve the calculation. SWITCH/CONTROL leads — she chooses. SURRENDER follows when she stops calculating.
quests.post: 'The calculation was wrong.' Pause. 'I would survive it.' She sounds surprised. 'I would mind, though.'

quests.name: Rebuilt From Scratch
quests.pre: She has been rebuilt from loss before. This is the reconstruction path working forward.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — VANILLA as frame, SURRENDER as core. She gives without the grief underneath the giving for the first time.
quests.post: 'He would have liked you.' She says this calmly. 'I am keeping you separate from that, which is itself significant.'

quests.name: What the Loremaster Adds
quests.desc: She adds one line to the Sunlit Court's history. Personal. She is the only one who would know what it means.

quests.name: Her Mother's Notes
quests.desc: The margin notes in the Deedbook. What they mean. That her mother was smarter than anyone gave her credit for and she has been proving this for six months.

quests.name: The Analysis That Runs Ahead
quests.pre: She analyses him as she analyses runic systems: component, function, reliability.
quests.scene: He does something unexpected. The analysis runs ahead of itself. She notes: 'Unexpected variable.'
quests.post: She watches for the variable again. It appears consistently.

quests.name: The Oath in Full
quests.desc: What the Durgrim Ledger oath actually says — all of it. Why she meant every word. What it means to commit something in stone.

quests.name: The Less Competent Position
quests.pre: She is always the most competent person in the room.
quests.scene: She is not. She is failing at something he does easily. She could cover this. She does not. She asks for help. 'I cannot do this one.'
quests.post: He helps. She receives help. This is the actual breakthrough.

quests.name: The Oath She Adds
quests.pre: She has been examining a new kind of oath — personal, not filed.
quests.scene: SUBMISSIVE/DEVOTION fully active — she gives with dwarven thoroughness. SERVICE as the form. BREEDING lean acknowledged at depth.
quests.post: She files something in a personal ledger. Not Durgrim's.

quests.name: Leaning
quests.pre: She has never leaned on anything.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy that ends with her leaning. Physically. She has been holding herself upright by competence for years. She puts some of the weight down.
quests.post: 'Lighter.' She says this like an engineering observation. 'Structurally, lighter.'

quests.name: The Better Rune
quests.desc: She finds one rune in the old text her mother missed. She codes it into a new ward design. She names it privately.

quests.name: The Raid She Cannot Remember
quests.desc: The childhood before Clan Redhorn — the gaps, the clan she belongs to now, that the gaps do not matter and do.

quests.name: Neither Question
quests.pre: He is the first person who has not asked whether she is more human or more orc.
quests.scene: She realises he has not asked. She waits for it. It does not come.
quests.post: She rides next to him. Not ahead. Next to.

quests.name: Ushara's Teaching
quests.desc: One specific lesson Ushara gave her. Why it matters. That some things are taught and some things are found.

quests.name: The Test She Does Not Name
quests.pre: Orc law says the stronger takes.
quests.scene: She tests him the specific way orc law says to test. He passes. She tests him differently. He passes again. She has run through her full testing inventory.
quests.post: She sits with this. 'Hm.'

quests.name: Marrowen at a Distance
quests.desc: She rode close to Marrowen once and looked at the farms and understood something and left. She has never said this to Ushara.

quests.name: The MASOCHIST Lean
quests.pre: She has been in a lot of fights.
quests.scene: He wins one. She does not get up immediately. The pause is not injury. She examines the pause. She challenges him again — loses again. The third time she stops examining the pause and stays in it.
quests.post: She stays in it.

quests.name: Being
quests.pre: She has been the question in every room.
quests.scene: He treats her as the answer — not to a question about what she is, but as a person who is fully present. SWITCH/VANILLA leads — she gives simply, without armor.
quests.post: 'That is what it feels like.'

quests.name: Not The Question
quests.pre: She has stopped rehearsing her identity in new situations.
quests.scene: Extended intimacy — MASOCHIST/SADIST oscillation, SWITCH fully active. She finds out she does not have to be either question in this room.
quests.post: 'Just me.'

quests.name: Clan and Something More
quests.pre: Clan first, then this. She has held that.
quests.scene: He asks what this is. She says: 'Clan, then you.' She means it as a compliment.
quests.post: She tells Ushara. Ushara says nothing. Ushara's expression says everything.
